character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A massive colossal grey werewolf with an immense muscular build, side view combat idle animation. Battle-scarred muzzle with bared sharp fangs, one scarred milky-blind eye, one fiercely glowing amber eye. Exceptionally thick, voluminous wild mane draping heavily around the neck and broad shoulders, coarse silver-grey fur crisscrossed with jagged battle scars, tattered loincloth. A distinct, visible glowing ethereal combat aura radiating intensely from behind the back, chest expanding rhythmically with deep heavy breaths, giant razor-sharp claws idling at waist level, no weapon. Clean bold outline, limited palette, chibi 3-head proportions.
